answer: Provenance crystal ledger. Each agent identity must reference a unique physical crystal whose optical fingerprint is verified at registration; the crystal is issued once per verified hardware root and cannot be duplicated digitally. Identities also log a voyage history of signed interactions, so a clone diverges and gets flagged. Attackers must acquire and physically hold one crystal per identity, plus maintain a separate lagoon of consistent interaction logs. Cost is hardware procurement and logistics, not capital alone.
